headline: School Committee to discuss shared use agreement for 135 Asa Pond Road facility, athletic trainer contract, and new high school project status.
summary: The South Kingstown School Committee will review a field trip to the Norman Rockwell Museum, a maintenance facility sharing agreement with the Town, an athletic trainer contract, and a school lunch service fee update. The committee will also get status updates on the new South Kingstown High School and a proposed parking plan.
items: Purchase orders over $10,350 for Sargent Rehabilitation Center and The Met Center
Annual PTO fundraisers for MES, PDES, and WKES
Field Trip approval: SKHS CTE Studio Art to Norman Rockwell Museum & Red Lion Inn, Stockbridge, MA
Memorandum of Agreement between Town of South Kingstown and School Department for shared use of School Maintenance Facility at 135 Asa Pond Road
Contract award for Professional Services - Athletic Trainer for Secondary Education Students
School Lunch Program - My School Bucks service fee contract update due to new RI state law limitations
School Building Committee status update on new South Kingstown High School and Athletic Field/Stadium Complex at Curtis Corner
Personnel actions: leaves of absence, resignation, and new hire of Head Boys Hockey Coach
Proposed Parking Plan update for South Kingstown High School (SY 2027-2028)
location: South Kingstown High School Cafeteria, 215 Columbia Street, Wakefield, RI 02879
